377YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: Ynez of the League became Cardinal of Prosperity, Asher of Highguard Cardinal of Courage, Jared of Highguard Cardinal of Loyalty and Samson of Highguard Cardinal of Pride, each after the previous holder was removed or contested. The General Assembly vetoed the Senate's decision to give the Brilliant Shore Bourse resource to Wintermark. The Assembly of Prosperity condemned Xavier Cascade for heresy and blasphemy, 90 to 0. A Statement of Principle now requires an Exemplar to win both a Greater Majority of the relevant Virtue Assembly and a Lesser Majority of the General Assembly, and to name the signs shown. The Marches Hospital, Phoenix Spire, Celesti Coven and Caleb of the Cenotaph each received one and a half Thrones. Proposed rewards to Azmon and to Lazarus of the Shattered Tower were defeated.

n.Dawn: Abaddon De Rondell of Dawn held the post of Cardinal of Wisdom. Lady Josephine Novarrion of Dawn lost the contest for Cardinal of Pride narrowly, by 50 votes to 54, while Avery Armistead of Dawn received 10.
n.Highguard: Highborn priests won three Cardinal seats, with Asher taking Courage, Jared taking Loyalty and Samson taking Pride, and Ira of Highguard secured the Synod's backing for a monument at Anvil to the Empire's military dead. Proposed rewards to Azmon and Lazarus of the Shattered Tower, raised by Highborn priests, were both defeated.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Assembly of Pride formally called on the Imperial Orcs to form a National Assembly in the Synod to oversee the virtue of their elected Imperial office-holders. Gralka, an Imperial Orc, served as Conscience of the Way.
n.Navarr: Hywel Summercrow of the Navarr carried the Statement of Principle tightening the requirements for recognising Exemplars by 414 votes to 52, and Meurig Tystwarden was retained as Gatekeeper of Pride. Tockryn Nighthaven of the Navarr secured one and a half Thrones for the Phoenix Spire of Urizen.
n.Urizen: The Phoenix Spire of Urizen received one and a half Thrones from the Virtue Fund. Laelia Shatterspire of Urizen led the successful veto of the Brilliant Shore Bourse seat going to Wintermark, and Cyrus Cascade was retained as Gatekeeper of Courage. Linden of Endsmeet and Sejanus Shatterspire received visions of their past lives.
n.Varushka: Olga of Miekarova was recognised as an Exemplar of Vigilance by a Greater Majority, on a judgement raised by Irada-Catchie Bandsyna of Varushka. Petra of Varushka held the post of Cardinal of Vigilance.
n.Wintermark: The Synod vetoed the Senate's assignment of the Brilliant Shore Bourse resource to Wintermark, and a bid to recognise Horsa Monster-slayer as an Exemplar of Courage failed to reach a Greater Majority. Ingar Saker and Horsa Tyrshalt received visions of their past lives.

t.Miekarova: Olga of Miekarova was recognised by the Assembly of Vigilance as an Exemplar of Vigilance, bringing Synod recognition to one of the territory's own people.

r.Miekarova/Srodkoja: Mentioned in passing: the page names Olga of Miekarova, recognised as an Exemplar of Vigilance, but says nothing about Srodkoja itself.

Allocate The Brilliant Shore.d: The procedural motion proposed making the Brilliant Shore a National Bourse position assigned to Wintermark. It passed the Senate by 21 votes to 4 at the Autumn Equinox 377YE, but the General Assembly of the Imperial Synod vetoed it, leaving the resource unassigned. The Civil Service noted that naming Wintermark was legally extraneous, because a national Bourse position is only open to citizens of the nation that controls the territory. At the Winter Solstice the question was raised again and passed 21 to 3. The Brilliant Shore became a National Bourse position, and production stockpiled since Autumn 377YE was held for the first citizen elected to operate it.

n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: Thule is not named on the page. It appears here only because Skarsind, where the Brilliant Shore lies, is recorded as held by Thule that season.
n.Wintermark: The Brilliant Shore's White Granite became a National Bourse position under Wintermark's control, open to election only by Wintermark citizens, though the Synod's veto delayed this by a season.

t.Skarsind: The Brilliant Shore White Granite source in Skarsind stood unassigned after the Autumn veto and became a National Bourse position at Winter, with its Autumn production stockpiled for its first elected operator.

Archive:377YE Autumn Equinox Imperial ti.d: The record lists every senator, general, cardinal, gatekeeper, archmage, grandmaster and Bourse holder after the Autumn Equinox. Several seats changed hands: senators were claimed in Casinea, Tassato, Morrow and Volodmartz, and new generals took the Fire of the South, Winter Sun, Wolves of War and Quiet Step. Septima of Shatterspire died, leaving the Warmage vacant until elections at the Winter Solstice. Bourse seats were extended to Winter 377 amid the Imperial crisis. The Brilliant Shore was reclaimed from the Thule, but the Synod's General Assembly vetoed its allocation. The Vigilant Swan, the Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund remained in Druj hands.

n.Dawn: Dawn kept its three senators, with Ywain De Gauvain retaining Semmerholm, and General Frederick Novarion kept the Eastern Sky. Agnetha De Rondell was appointed Cardinal of Wisdom and Maurice de Gauvain was declared Archmage of Autumn.
n.Druj: The Druj held the Great Forest at Reikos, the Great Pits of Ennerlund and the Vigilant Swan, none of which will be auctioned while they remain in orc hands.
n.Highguard: Zephram of Cantiarch's Hold claimed the Casinea seat, and Highguard took four of the eight cardinalships, with Asher at Courage, Samson at Pride and Jared at Loyalty. The nation lost the Vigilant Swan to the Druj with the fall of Reikos.
n.Imperial Orcs: Bloodcrow Martok replaced Klor as general of the Winter Sun, a change marked as yet to be confirmed, and Braka kept the Summer Storm. Stormcrow Gralka remained Conscience of the Senate, Kessek served as Advisor on Orc Affairs and Bruk held the Steel Fist.
n.Navarr: Caerwyn Summer Crow kept Therunin and General Cerunnos kept the Black Thorns, while Gwai replaced Kale Vigil at the Quiet Step. Hywel Summercrow became Gatekeeper of the Wisdom Assembly and Meir Pathfinder led the Rod and Shield with a voting strength of 22.
n.The Brass Coast: Rauul i Jannat i Requiza kept Kahraman, and Anwar i Covas i Erigo replaced Yasmina as general of the Fire of the South. Edmundo I Jannat I Riqueza became Grandmaster of the Golden Pyramid, and Tabib i Eldaha i Riqueza held the Broken Shore Bounty.
n.The League: Cesare claimed the Tassato seat and Gabriel Barossa replaced Stanislav Krieger at the Wolves of War. Ynez became Cardinal of Prosperity alongside Olek and Bishop Antonnio Vanzetti, and League citizens held many Bourse seats as well as the Regario Dossier and the Imperial Mint.
n.The Marches: Henry Ward retained Upwold and General William Tanner kept the Bounders, and Friar Alan Young stayed Gatekeeper of Loyalty. The Marcher William Bolholt lost the Golden Pyramid grandmastership.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: the Brilliant Shore is noted as having been reclaimed from the Thule.
n.Urizen: Lucius of Quicksilver Spire claimed Morrow from Ioseph, and Hector kept Zenith after his re-election, protecting him from revocation for now. Darius of Auric Horizon replaced Callisius Quicksilver as Archmage of Day, and Valerian of Phoenix Reach held the Legacy.
n.Varushka: Valentin Ivarovich Severy claimed Volodmartz from Maxim, and Petra Petrivna Melikov remained Cardinal of Vigilance. Dimitri Ivanovich Ionescu took the Shuttered Lantern with a strength of 35, Alexei led the Unfettered Mind and Simargl remained Dean of the Lyceum.
n.Wintermark: Hengest Dun retained Hahnmark and Triva of Tyrshalt was listed as Senator for Skarsind, with that seat next up at the Spring Equinox 378YE. Wyrda Bjornadottir was replaced as Grandmaster of the Shuttered Lantern, and Joakim held the Stonefield Ice Caves.

r.Holberg/Ennerlund: The Great Pits of Ennerlund were held by the Druj and will not be auctioned until Holberg is once again an Imperial territory.

Assignment of Skarsind.d: In Autumn 377YE the Senate held a procedural vote on which Imperial nation should receive the newly conquered territory of Skarsind. The motion assigned it to Wintermark and passed unanimously. As a result, Skarsind formally became part of the nation of Wintermark.

n.Thule: Skarsind, recorded as held by the Thule that season, was formally treated as conquered land and assigned to an Imperial nation, confirming that the territory had passed out of Thule hands.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark received Skarsind by unanimous Senate vote, adding the conquered territory to its lands.

t.Skarsind: Skarsind was formally assigned to Wintermark as conquered territory and became part of that nation.

Construct Liathaven spy network.d: Proposed by the Senator for Miaren and seconded by the Senator for Hercynia, the motion passed 25 votes to 3 and was approved at 10 Thrones. Construction required 10 wains of weirwood and three months. Rhys, Senator for Miaren, supplied the weirwood after the Spring Equinox 378YE. Once complete, any Imperial citizen could assign military units under their control to support the network. With enough units committed, it would reveal a map of Liathaven's settlements, then the location and nature of armies, naval routes and trading partners, and finally the location and size of fortifications. The intelligence would go to those who assigned units.

n.Jotun: Because Liathaven was held by the Jotun at the time, the network was set up to uncover their settlements, armies, naval routes, trading partners and fortifications in the territory.

t.Liathaven: The Empire commissioned a spy network in Jotun-held Liathaven. Once units were committed to it, it could map the territory's settlements, armies, sea routes, trading partners and fortifications.

Create title of Quartermaster General of.d: Proposed by Astolat and seconded by Morrow, the motion originally sought a Minister for Resupply in Miaren. The Senate was advised that a great work automatically resupplying armies based in Miaren was impossible without a source of mithril or weirwood to meet the costs, so senators created an Imperial title instead. It passed at 25 Thrones, 16 votes to 8, with a stipend of 25 Thrones per season from the Senate budget. Its powers were initially unclear. Procedural motions at the Winter Solstice Summit 377YE established that the Quartermaster General could only resupply an Imperial army. Such resupply would be announced to the Senate without a vote and would remain subject to the Synod's veto.

n.Navarr: The motion was prompted by a wish to secure emergency resupply for Imperial armies fighting in the Navarr territory of Miaren. The result was an Empire-wide title rather than a Navarr-specific measure.

t.Miaren: The Senate had hoped to build a great work in Miaren to resupply armies stationed there automatically. It was told this could not be done without mithril or weirwood, and created a general resupply title instead.

Resupply the Quiet Step.d: Proposed by Sarvos and seconded by Upwold, the motion sought emergency resupply for the Quiet Step using 25 wains of weirwood costed at 7½ crowns per wain, on a pass-at-this-sum-or-withdraw basis. It passed unanimously and the monies were disbursed to Sarvos. After the Winter Solstice 377YE, Mirislav, senator for Sarvos, provided the 25 wains of weirwood. The Senate authorised the weirwood to be spent resupplying the Quiet Step until the end of Summer 378YE.

n.Navarr: The Navarr army the Quiet Step was granted emergency resupply, with 25 wains of weirwood authorised for its use until the end of Summer 378YE.
n.The League: The League's senator for Sarvos proposed the motion and received the funds, and Senator Mirislav later supplied the 25 wains of weirwood to resupply the Navarr army.

t.Sarvos: The motion was proposed by the senator for Sarvos, the monies were disbursed there, and Mirislav, senator for Sarvos, provided the weirwood after the Winter Solstice.
